propositions: Arm B minimal harness agent produces 5 false-FAIL rejections on real ACs across the corpus while Arm A production verifier produces 0, contradicting the hypothesis that in-process scaffolding is the source of unreliability.

Arm B achieved 0 false-PASS verdicts on planted-unmet ACs and 94.6% per-AC agreement with ground truth, meeting or exceeding false-positive safety but failing rejection-count and wall-time predeclared thresholds.

The predeclared NO-GO decision rule requires all three conditions (false-PASS=0, rejections strictly less, wall-time ≤2×) to hold; Arm B satisfies condition (i) but fails (ii) and (iii), invalidating the external-harness verifier justification.

Arm B's 5 rejections concentrate on 0e68 epic AC7 (stamp and mapping mutation landing in one commit) and AC2 (both projects' enrichment data present), which Arm A unanimously passed, indicating defensible but strict-literal readings of multi-clause acceptance criteria.
